armor_set.alshanex_familiars.familiar_se:
Set Bonus:
When a tamed familiar dies, it will get stunned for some seconds instead.
Gives up to +25% magic school power.
Gives up to +50% familiar damage reduction.
Shift for details.

Set Bonus:
When a tamed familiar dies, it will get stunned for some seconds instead. The time each familiar stays stunned increases relative to the amount of currently summoned familiars.
Gives up to +25% magic school power bonus, the bonus depends on the currently summoned familiars and their preferred power attributes.
Gives up to +50% familiar damage reduction, the amount decreases with the amount of currently summoned familiars.
Summon familiars to gain spell power
